Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding school employee duty to report suspected child abuse or neglect.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to school employee duty to report suspected childabuse or neglect; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.400 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.400RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A school employee who has witnessed or has reasonable cause tobelieve that a student has suffered abuse or neglect by any person,including other school personnel, shall cause a report to be made tothe proper law enforcement agency or to the department of social andhealth services as required under RCW 26.44.030. (2) School employees shall receive training regarding theirreporting obligations under state law in their orientation trainingwhen hired and then every three years. The training required underthis subsection shall take place within existing training programs andrelated resources.
